notes.title: Whispers from the Queen's Throne: July Update + Price Reveal
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/559051b3ddbbf47a378c7798b3fa04c39a2b5cbb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Artwork on the cover is by the talented [url="https://www.x.com/greseadraws"]Gresea[/url]![/i][/p][h3]Happy July, everyone! [/h3][p]Eldar here from Monster Theater with a quick update on where we're at with The Dark Queen of Mortholme's Steam port. [/p][p]Well, first things first...

We recently put out a [url="https://www.gamespress.com/en-US/The-Dark-Queen-of-Mortholme-comes-to-Steam-and-GOG-August-15th"]press release[/url] that outlines what you can expect from the game's launch and, of course, the price. [/p][p]The Dark Queen of Mortholme will launch at [b]$5.99 (USD or local equivalent) with a 15% launch discount.[/b][/p][p]Now... [/p][p]How about a wishlist update...?[/p][h1]The Dark Queen of Mortholme has hit 60,000 wishlists![/h1][p]Thank you ALL so much for showing us that you really, truly care about this short form indie. We can't wait for you all to experience the game again on Steam. [/p][p]We'd love to see you in the [b]Monster Theater Discord[/b], where you can join other fans of The Dark Queen of Mortholme![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3"]https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3[/url][/p][p]Reminder that the Steam port will have the following:[/p][list][*][p]Full Xbox and PlayStation controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud Support[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]A dozen added languages[/p][/*][/list][p]Have you followed us on socials yet? Would love to see you on Twitter, Instagram, Threads, and BlueSky![/p][p][b]All of our socials are below.[/b][/p][p][url="https://monstertheater.carrd.co/"]https://monstertheater.carrd.co/[/url] [/p][p][/p][h2]August 15th is only 25 days away! Have you wishlisted yet?[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/e83d65c31f23aca75fe12becf522b73c52d83bff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Thank you for 20,000 wishlists!
notes.content:
[h1]In just a little over a week, you've helped us break the 20,000 wishlist barrier. That's amazing![/h1]

When Mosu and the Monster Theater team set out to bring [b]The Dark Queen of Mortholme[/b] to Steam, we wanted to keep it faithful to the original itch.io release, but with a host of quality of life improvements, and we're beyond excited that the Steam community has found the game and is awaiting it's release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/1327985fda6a17253adbcda79a2b93c184d63120.png[/img]

[h2]Here's what you can expect, as a reminder. [/h2]

[list]
[*] Full PlayStation and Xbox Controller support
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Multiple Endings
[*] Steam Cloud 
[*] Over a dozen additional localized languages 
[/list]
We can't wait for everyone to experience the story of the Dark Queen, and we hope you consider it a wonderful indie title to add to your Steam library. 

[b]Thank you for supporting short-form indie games! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633797/559051b3ddbbf47a378c7798b3fa04c39a2b5cbb.png[/img]

Come say hi to the devs in the [url=https://discord.gg/Kj2wfmY7r3]Discord[/url]~

You can also grab some amazing rewards over on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/MonsterTheater]Patreon[/url]~

Be well,
Eldar and the Monster Theater team
